# Abstract
Paper-a studies solvent screening for MOF catalysis in a small batch reactor.

## Methods
The core method is solvent screening across 40 reaction records.

## Results
The best condition reports 82% conversion under mild conditions.

## Limitations
The main limitation is the small batch scale.
